answer_1.quote: We propose a method, TRACER, to automatically generate target-oriented shopping conversations without any human annotations.
answer_1.outputs: shopping dialogues between customer and seller agents

answer_2.quote: Table 7 shows the mean reciprocal rank (MRR) and Hit@k of all methods.

answer_4.quote: Since there is no gold conversation to evaluate against as we explained §2, we perform human evaluation at the conversation and utterance levels to examine the quality of the dialogues.
answer_4.guideline: Judges are asked to score each conversation on a 5-point Likert scale for Realism, Conciseness, Coherence and Overall naturalness. For utterance-level evaluation, judges identify all unsatisfactory, non-script following utterances.
